This craft diet soda provides a guilt-free beverage choice that complements any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Perfect for health-conscious diners seeking a flavorful alternative to regular sodas without artificial sweeteners or added sugars.

The stevia-sweetened formula delivers sweetness without the caloric impact of traditional sodas or sugar-laden drinks.

Unlike conventional diet sodas loaded with artificial sweeteners, this craft beverage uses only carbonated water, natural flavors, and stevia. The Maine Root brand is known for premium, small-batch sodas that prioritize quality and natural ingredients over mass-market alternatives.

This clean formulation aligns with Maine Root's craft beverage philosophy and CAVA's commitment to quality ingredients throughout their menu offerings.

The carbonation provides satisfying fizz while natural flavors deliver authentic soda taste without artificial aftertaste. Unlike some diet sodas with chemical notes, Maine Root maintains a clean flavor profile that complements meals without overwhelming your palate or leaving unwanted sweetness lingering.

While water remains the healthiest choice, this provides a satisfying option for those craving carbonation without compromising dietary goals or consuming added sugars that impact blood glucose levels.
howToOrder: Order Maine Root Diet Soda (16 oz) directly from the drinks section when building your CAVA meal in-store or online. Simply add it to your order alongside your bowl, pita, or sides. The 16 oz size provides ample refreshment for your meal. Ask CAVA team members if you want to explore other beverage options available on the menu.

worthTrying: Maine Root Diet Soda (16 oz) is absolutely worth trying for health-conscious CAVA guests seeking flavorful zero-calorie refreshment.
